judged_text: Every request for a not-yet-imported embed_url unconditionally enqueues a retrieve_topic job; the dedup/throttle (redis setnx) lives inside the job, not at enqueue time. A popular article that fails or delays import (e.g., embed_by_username unset, host mismatch, upstream down) gets one sidekiq job enqueued per page view per visitor; the queue floods with no-op jobs that each only discover the throttle after dequeue, starving the job queue for the duration of the traffic spike.

adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, when TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url) is nil it always calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ... embed_url: embed_url)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb) on every request, with no enqueue-time dedup/throttle. The only throttle is in TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently? using Redis `setnx` (lib/topic_retriever.rb), which runs when the job is executed (via Jobs::RetrieveTopic#execute). If import cannot complete (e.g., TopicRetriever#fetch_http returns early when `embed_by_username` user is blank, or host mismatch/invalid URL), topic_id stays nil and subsequent page views keep enqueueing more jobs, potentially flooding Sidekiq with no-op jobs and starving other work.
